image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from the front. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, blank key at the bottom center (the space bar) which features ornate gold/brass decorative scrollwork. Above the keyboard are rows of round, glass-topped keys with metal rims. The carriage and platen are visible at the top.
